start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:describe-what-happens-before-naming-it." Find out what is actually happening in any subject, and under which conditions it holds or fails, before choosing its dimensions, goals, tradeoffs or name: describe it in observable terms, sort every stated requirement into observed, assumed or inherited, keep only the distinctions that change the outcome, derive the fewest principles the evidence supports, and only then propose dimensions (each with a test that could reject it) and a name that claims no more than what was derived.
